note: Ready-made examples for /try. Every photo is honestly what its name says (content/verify/fixtures/credits.json). None shows a product its owner made safe: those come from the team's own photos, listed in content/verify/fixtures/user/expected.json once they are taken. Runs that need Claude replay one recorded live answer from content/presets/recorded/, so pressing Run costs nothing; every check around that answer runs again in code.

presets.title: The CPSC's own made-safe photo
presets.summary: The photo the CPSC published with recall 26125: a hair dryer with its cord cut in half.
presets.photo_alt: A hand-held hair dryer with its power cord cut through, the two cut ends side by side.
presets.photo_credit: US Consumer Product Safety Commission (cpsc.gov), recall 26125. Public domain.

expected.plain: Remedy recognizes the recall's own example photo and asks for the owner's photo. No payout.

technical.note: Run again with the official-image match switched off, so you can see what the photo checks read: C1 and C2 saw the right product with the cord cut.

presets.title: The official recall picture
presets.summary: The CPSC's own picture of the HAIARA power bank in recall 27056, sent as if it were a claim photo.
presets.photo_alt: The front of a black HAIARA power bank, model W5 PRO, on a white background.
presets.photo_credit: US Consumer Product Safety Commission (cpsc.gov), recall 27056. Public domain.

expected.plain: Send a photo of your own product. No payout, and no model call: the match with the official picture is found in code.

presets.title: A blurry photo
presets.summary: A photo blurred on purpose, sent for the power bank recall 27056.
presets.photo_alt: A very blurred photo of a mug of coffee on a table.
presets.photo_credit: Blurred copy of "Coffee in a mug" by Kurt Kaiser, via Wikimedia Commons. CC0 1.0.

expected.plain: A friendly retake: hold still and try again. Found before any model call.

presets.title: Something else entirely
presets.summary: A mug of coffee, sent for the HAIARA power bank recall 27056.
presets.photo_alt: A white mug of black coffee on a wooden table.
presets.photo_credit: "Coffee in a mug" by Kurt Kaiser, via Wikimedia Commons. CC0 1.0.

expected.plain: The right-product check does not pass, so there is no payout, and the owner hears what to send instead.
